merchant_bjorn.name: Bjorn the Trader
merchant_bjorn.description: The grasslands town merchant. Friendly: players cannot attack him and he never aggroes.
dialogue: Welcome, traveler! Take a look at my wares.

npc_harrow_captain.name: Captain Bessa Harrow
dialogue: Harrow's Rest holds because nobody has told it to fall yet. Stay inside the stakes after dark, and don't cross the bridge alone.

npc_harrow_guard_tam.name: Tam Pellow
dialogue: Road's yours as far as the bridge. Past the bridge, it's theirs.

npc_harrow_guard_iselle.name: Iselle Dunmore
dialogue: Mind the mist in the vale. Things stand in it and don't move until you're close.

npc_harrow_guard_orrin.name: Orrin Blackwater
dialogue: Some nights you can see the Lantern Tower's brazier from here, up on the keep. That's Vane's men laughing at us.

npc_harrow_guard_wyn.name: Wyn Cotter
dialogue: Chased a brigand runner up under the ridge once. There's cold air coming out of the rocks under the tor, cold as a cellar. I didn't stay to learn why.

npc_harrow_smith.name: Hedda Stroud
dialogue: Iron's dear this far from a town. Bring me back what the renegades drop and we'll talk.

npc_harrow_armourer.name: Pol Garrick
dialogue: Ashvane plate, if you can pry it off them. I can make it fit you.

npc_harrow_provisioner.name: Mother Ada Quill
dialogue: Bread, salt pork, bandages. Nothing fancy, nothing poisoned, which is more than the cultists can say.

npc_harrow_trader.name: Corwen Ashby
dialogue: I buy anything that isn't still bleeding. Barrow trinkets fetch the best price, if you're brave.

npc_harrow_innkeeper.name: Maud Fenwick
dialogue: A bed's a bed, even one this close to the vale. Don't track the mist in with you.
